response.sql:
WITH type_counts AS (
  SELECT
    t.tradekind,
    COUNT(*) AS behavior_count
  FROM advancedbehavior AS ab
  JOIN transactionrecord AS tr
    ON ab.translink = tr.transreg
  JOIN trader AS t
    ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg
  GROUP BY t.tradekind
),
shares AS (
  SELECT
    tradekind,
    behavior_count,
    behavior_count::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(behavior_count) OVER (), 0) AS share
  FROM type_counts
),
scored AS (
  SELECT
    tradekind,
    behavior_count,
    share,
    AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share
  FROM shares
)
SELECT
  tradekind,
  behavior_count,
  share,
  share - average_share AS share_minus_average
FROM scored
WHERE average_share IS NOT NULL
  AND share > average_share;

assumptions.assumption: A missing trader type means SQL NULL; GROUP BY treats all such values as one type group, returned as NULL.
